lines.name: Wenhu Line
lines.description: Medium-capacity automated line (Muzha Line 1996, Neihu Line 2009).

lines.name: Tamsui-Xinyi Line
lines.description: Tamsui Line 1997, Xinyi Line 2013; Xiangshan - Guangci/Fengtian Temple east extension opened 2026-08-30.

lines.name: Circular Line
lines.description: Phase 1 Dapinglin - New Taipei Industrial Park opened 2020-01-31 (medium capacity, driverless). South and North sections: comprehensive plan approved 2019-05-31, all civil contracts under way (34% at end of Oct 2026), target 2031 (some reports 2028-2034). East section: approved 2023-03-29, works since late 2024, target Sept 2032. Future station names provisional; final station codes not published.

segments.label: South section, Taipei Zoo - Dapinglin (construction, target 2031)
North section, New Taipei Industrial Park - Jiannan Road (construction, target 2031)
East section, Jiannan Road - Taipei Zoo (construction, target 2032)

lines.name: Wanda-Zhonghe-Shulin Line
lines.description: Comprehensive plan approved 2010-02-12. Phase 1 (CKS Memorial Hall - Juguang, 9.5 km, underground) is in system testing, target 2027 (June or end of year; sources differ). Phase 2 (Juguang - Huilong, 13.3 km) under construction (45% mid-2026), target 2031 (New Taipei aims for 2030). Phase-2 station names provisional.

lines.name: Minsheng-Xizhi Line
lines.description: Feasibility approved 2011-12. Xidong section (Donghu - Xizhi District Office, 5.56 km elevated) approved 2023-01-13, works since 2025-03-20, target 2032. Taipei section (Dadaocheng - Donghu, ~11 km underground) comprehensive plan resubmitted 2024-12, not yet approved (no target year). Station names and positions provisional.

segments.label: Taipei section SB01-SB10 (comprehensive plan under review)

lines.name: Danhai Light Rail
lines.description: Green Mountain Line (Hongshulin - Kanding) opened 2018-12; Blue Coast Line phase 1 (Binhai Shalun - Tamsui Fisherman's Wharf) 2020-11. Phase 2 (Fisherman's Wharf - Tamsui, 3.32 km): the network plan was approved 2013-02-25, but the revised riverside alignment is still under review (sent to the National Development Council 2026-10-29); target 2030. Phase-2 stop names provisional.

segments.label: Blue Coast Line phase 2, Fisherman's Wharf - Tamsui (revised plan under review, target 2030)

lines.name: Ankeng Light Rail
lines.description: Shuangcheng - Shisizhang, opened 2023-02-10. No extension in any adopted plan.

lines.name: Sanying Line
lines.description: Dingpu - Yingtao Fude (14.29 km, elevated, medium capacity) opened 2026-06-30. Bade extension (4.03 km, 3 stations to Danan on the Taoyuan Green Line): comprehensive plan approved 2025-08-01; a start ceremony was held 2026-11-13 but only drilling and test pits follow (site works from 2027), so it is shown as approved; target 2034. Extension station names provisional.

segments.label: Bade extension, LB12-LB14 (approved; ceremony 2026-11-13, works from 2027; target 2034)

lines.name: Keelung MRT
lines.description: Nangang - Badu, 15.6 km medium-capacity line built by New Taipei. Comprehensive plan approved 2024-01-31; only a small advance-works site (Baifu, from 2025-12-30) so far and the main tenders are being re-run; the cost estimate (NT$126 bn) exceeds the approved NT$69.7 bn, so a revised plan is needed. Target 2033. Shares Zhangshuwan - Xizhi District Office with the Xidong section. Phase 2 Badu - Keelung (proposed, route undecided) not drawn. No official colour (map colour). Station names provisional.

lines.name: Shenkeng Light Rail
lines.description: Taipei Zoo - Beishen Road, 5.81 km, 5 stations. Feasibility approved; the comprehensive plan is with the Executive Yuan awaiting approval (no target year; "six years after approval"). No official colour (map colour). Stops approximate.

lines.name: Wugu-Taishan Light Rail
lines.description: Fenziwei (Circular North) - Luzhou - Wugu - Wenzaizhen, 11.64 km, 14 stations. Feasibility approved, environmental review passed 2026-03-04, comprehensive plan awaiting Executive Yuan approval (press estimates 2032-2035; no official year). No official colour (map colour). Station names provisional.

lines.name: Taoyuan Airport MRT
lines.description: Taipei Main Station - Huanbei opened 2017-03-02; Laojie River (A22) 2023-07-31. Extension to Zhongli Station (A23, co-built with the underground TRA station) under construction, target July 2028. A14 Airport Terminal 3 station (between A13 and A14a) is under construction for end-2027 and is not drawn.

lines.name: Taoyuan Green Line
lines.description: Bade - Taoyuan Station - Luzhu - Airport City, 27.8 km. North stretch G11-G15b is complete but not open (inspections pending as of mid-Oct 2026; city target still end of 2026). G08-G10 target 2028, G01-G07 2030, Airport City section G15b-G19 end-2032 (low confidence). Zhongli extension (Zhongli Station - G01, ~7.2 km) works since 2026-08-26, target 2031. Daxi extension (proposed) not drawn. English names are unofficial.

segments.label: North stretch G11-G15b (complete, awaiting inspection; target end-2026)
Airport City section G15b-G19 (partly under construction, target end-2032)
Zhongli extension, Zhongli Station - G01 (construction since 2026-08, target 2031)

lines.name: Taoyuan Brown Line
lines.description: Taoyuan Station - Huilong, 11.38 km. Comprehensive plan approved 2024-03-01; advance works (utility relocation, overpass demolition) since ~July 2026, E&M contract awarded 2026-07-27, main civil works being tendered. Target 2032. BR03 reserved; station names provisional.

lines.name: Western Line
lines.description: TRA Western Trunk Line: Keelung - Taipei 1891, Taipei - Hsinchu 1893; underground through Taipei (1989-2011). Clipped at the map edge west of Yangmei. TRA has no official line colours (TRA navy used).

lines.name: Taoyuan Railway Underground Project
lines.description: Moves 17.95 km of the Western Line (Fengming - Pingzhen) underground and adds infill stations Zhonglu, Taoyuan Hospital and Zhongyuan (under construction; the railway bureau gives 2033 for the tunnel and 2034 for the new stations, one report says Zhongyuan end-2030). Temporary Fengming (2024-11-30) and Pingzhen (2026-10-03) stations are already open. New station positions approximate. Colour chosen for the map.

lines.name: Yilan Line
lines.description: Badu - Ruifang - Sandiaoling (completed to Su'ao 1924), clipped at the map edge. Colour chosen for the map.

lines.name: Pingxi Line
lines.description: Sandiaoling - Jingtong branch (opened 1921 as a coal railway). Colour chosen for the map.

lines.name: Shen'ao Line
lines.description: Ruifang - Badouzi branch; passenger service restored 2014 (to Haikeguan) and extended to Badouzi 2016. Colour chosen for the map.

lines.name: Taiwan High Speed Rail
lines.description: Taipei/Banqiao - Zuoying opened 2007, Nangang 2016; shown to Hsinchu. Yilan extension (Nangang - Yilan, ~60.6 km, mostly tunnel, one new station): comprehensive plan approved by the Executive Yuan 2026-07-23, construction expected from 2029, opening 2036-2037 (sources differ; 2036 shown). Yilan station position approximate. Colour: THSR brand orange (no official line colour).

notes: Covers Taipei, New Taipei, Taoyuan and Keelung, clipped to lng 121.10-121.85 / lat 24.85-25.30 (TRA lines are cut at the last station inside that box; THSR is shown to Hsinchu). Geometry and station positions © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL (metro and LRT from route relations; TRA, THSR and the Danhai Blue Coast branch routed on the OSM track network; simplified ~15 m). Interchanges are merged when stations share a name within ~450 m (臺/台 and the 車站 suffix are ignored, so Taipei Main Station joins TRA, THSR, MRT and Airport MRT). Differently named transfers (Ximen/Beimen, Wanhua/Longshan Temple) stay separate. Colours: Taipei Metro, Airport MRT and New Taipei Metro lines use the values published in the operators' line diagrams as collected on Wikipedia (no official hex specification was found); TRA and THSR have no line colours (TRA navy / blues and THSR orange chosen for the map); future lines without an announced colour use the colour each city has used in plan documents. Segment years are first-opening years of each section. Future station names are provisional working names (most English names are unofficial romanisations) and their positions are approximate. Status rules applied literally: groundbreaking ceremonies without site works are not counted as construction (Sanying Bade extension, Keelung MRT), plans awaiting Executive Yuan approval are planned (Minsheng-Xizhi Taipei section, Shenkeng LRT, Wugu-Taishan LRT). Not included: Maokong Gondola; Airport MRT A14 Terminal 3 station (construction, end-2027, between A13 and A14a); proposed Green Line Daxi extension, Taoyuan Orange Line, Shezi/Beitou-Shilin LRT, Taishan-Banqiao LRT, Zhonghe-Guangfu line, Danhai extension to Bali, Keelung MRT phase 2 (no fixed alignment).
